name: richardsonIterate_succ
stmt:
lemma richardsonIterate_succ (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (b : E) (ω : ℝ) (x0 : E) (k : ℕ) :
    richardsonIterate A b ω x0 (k + 1) = richardson A b ω (richardsonIterate A b ω x0 k)
proof:
by
  unfold richardsonIterate
  rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: richardsonIterate_error
doc: 误差递推：e_{k+1} 的误差算子作用形式。
stmt:
lemma richardsonIterate_error (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (b xs : E) (ω : ℝ) (x0 : E)
    (hxs : A xs = b) (k : ℕ) :
    richardsonIterate A b ω x0 (k + 1) - xs =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E - ω • A) (richardsonIterate A b ω x0 k - xs)
proof:
by
  rw [richardsonIterate_succ]
  exact richardson_error A b xs (richardsonIterate A b ω x0 k) ω hxs

name: richardson_converges
doc: 主定理：0 ≤ c < 1 且 ‖1 − ωA‖ ≤ c ⟹ Richardson 迭代 ε-终止。
stmt:
theorem richardson_converges (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (b xs x0 : E) (ω c : ℝ)
    (hxs : A xs = b) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1)
    (hc : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E - ω • A‖ ≤ c) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ k : ℕ, ‖richardsonIterate A b ω x0 k - xs‖ < ε
proof:
by
  have hstep : ∀ k : ℕ,
      ‖richardsonIterate A b ω x0 (k + 1) - xs‖ ≤ c * ‖richardsonIterate A b ω x0 k - xs‖ := by
    intro k
    rw [richardsonIterate_succ]
    exact richardson_contraction A b xs (richardsonIterate A b ω x0 k) ω c hxs hc
  have := contraction_converges
    (e := fun k => ‖richardsonIterate A b ω x0 k - xs‖) c
    hc0 hc1 hstep (fun k => norm_nonneg _)
  exact this

name: richardson_converges_geometric
doc: 几何衰减界：‖eₖ‖ ≤ c^k·‖e₀‖。
stmt:
theorem richardson_converges_geometric (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (b xs x0 : E) (ω c : ℝ)
    (hxs : A xs = b) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c)
    (hc : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E - ω • A‖ ≤ c) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, ‖richardsonIterate A b ω x0 k - xs‖ ≤ c ^ k * ‖richardsonIterate A b ω x0 0 - xs‖
proof:
by
  have hstep : ∀ k : ℕ,
      ‖richardsonIterate A b ω x0 (k + 1) - xs‖ ≤ c * ‖richardsonIterate A b ω x0 k - xs‖ := by
    intro k
    rw [richardsonIterate_succ]
    exact richardson_contraction A b xs (richardsonIterate A b ω x0 k) ω c hxs hc
  exact contraction_pow_bound (e := fun k => ‖richardsonIterate A b ω x0 k - xs‖) c hc0 hstep

name: richardson_matCLME_sub
doc:
矩阵减法的 matCLME 桥：matCLME (M − N) = matCLME M − matCLME N。
（命名前缀 `richardson_`：为避免与既有 `RealSparsity.matCLME_sub` 跨文件重名而前缀化。）
stmt:
lemma richardson_matCLME_sub (M N : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    matCLME (M - N) = matCLME M - matCLME N
proof:
by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rw [matCLME_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, matCLME_apply, matCLME_apply]
  change Matrix.mulVec (M - N) x = Matrix.mulVec M x - Matrix.mulVec N x
  rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec]

name: matCLME_one
stmt:
lemma matCLME_one :
    matCLME (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
proof:
by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rw [matCLME_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]
  change Matrix.mulVec (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) x = x
  rw [Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: jacobi_operator_eq
doc: 迭代算子恒等式：1 − 1·(D⁻¹A) = 1 − D⁻¹A（作为连续线性算子）。
stmt:
lemma jacobi_operator_eq (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (d : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) - (1 : ℝ) • matCLME (diagScale d * A) =
      matCLME (jacobiIterMatrix A d)
proof:
by
  rw [one_smul, jacobiIterMatrix, richardson_matCLME_sub, matCLME_one]

name: jacobi_contraction
doc: Jacobi 收缩：迭代矩阵算子范数 ≤ c ⟹ 误差每步收缩 c。
stmt:
theorem jacobi_contraction (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (d : Fin n → ℝ)
    (b xs x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (hxs : matvecE A xs = b) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ‖matCLME (jacobiIterMatrix A d)‖ ≤ c) :
    ‖jacobiStep A d b x - xs‖ ≤ c * ‖x - xs‖
proof:
by
  have hxs' : matCLME (diagScale d * A) xs = matvecE (diagScale d) b := by
    rw [matCLME_apply, matvecE_mul, hxs]
  have hc' : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) -
      (1 : ℝ) • matCLME (diagScale d * A)‖ ≤ c := by
    rwa [jacobi_operator_eq A d]
  exact richardson_contraction (matCLME (diagScale d * A)) (matvecE (diagScale d) b) xs x 1 c hxs' hc'

name: diag_dominant_iter_matrix_row_sum_lt_one
doc:
严格对角占优 ⟹ Jacobi 迭代矩阵的行和（∞-范数）< 1。
逐元素展开：对角元 = 0，非对角元 = −(Aᵢᵢ)⁻¹Aᵢⱼ，行和 = |Aᵢᵢ|⁻¹·Σ_{j≠i}|Aᵢⱼ|。
stmt:
theorem diag_dominant_iter_matrix_row_sum_lt_one (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hdiag : ∀ i, A i i ≠ 0)
    (hdom : ∀ i, ∑ j in (Finset.univ.erase i), |A i j| < |A i i|) :
    ∀ i, ∑ j : Fin n, |jacobiIterMatrix A (fun i => A i i) i j| < 1
proof:
by
  intro i
  have hpos : 0 < |A i i| := abs_pos.mpr (hdiag i)
  have hdiag0 : jacobiIterMatrix A (fun i => A i i) i i = 0 := by
    unfold jacobiIterMatrix diagScale
    rw [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul, if_pos rfl,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (hdiag i), sub_self]
  have hoff : ∀ j : Fin n, j ≠ i →
      |jacobiIterMatrix A (fun i => A i i) i j| = |A i i|⁻¹ * |A i j| := by
    intro j hji
    unfold jacobiIterMatrix diagScale
    rw [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul,
      if_neg (fun h : i = j => hji h.symm), zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_inv]
  have hsum_erase : (∑ j in (Finset.univ.erase i),
        |jacobiIterMatrix A (fun i => A i i) i j|) =
      |A i i|⁻¹ * ∑ j in (Finset.univ.erase i), |A i j| := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hoff j (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1]
  have hsplit := Finset.sum_eq_sum_diff_singleton_add (Finset.mem_univ i)
    (fun j => |jacobiIterMatrix A (fun i => A i i) i j|)
  rw [Finset.sdiff_singleton_eq_erase] at hsplit
  rw [hsplit, hdiag0, abs_zero, add_zero, hsum_erase]
  calc
    |A i i|⁻¹ * (∑ j in (Finset.univ.erase i), |A i j|) < |A i i|⁻¹ * |A i i| :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hdom i) (inv_pos.mpr hpos)
    _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ (abs_ne_zero.mpr (hdiag i))

name: preconditionedRichardson_contraction
doc: 预条件收缩：‖1 − ωM⁻¹A‖ ≤ c ⟹ 误差每步收缩 c（Gauss–Seidel 的界的一般形式）。
stmt:
theorem preconditionedRichardson_contraction (Minv A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (b xs x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (ω c : ℝ) (hxs : matvecE A xs = b)
    (hc : ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) -
      ω • matCLME (Minv * A)‖ ≤ c) :
    ‖preconditionedRichardson Minv A b x ω - xs‖ ≤ c * ‖x - xs‖
proof:
by
  have hxs' : matCLME (Minv * A) xs = matvecE Minv b := by
    rw [matCLME_apply, matvecE_mul, hxs]
  exact richardson_contraction (matCLME (Minv * A)) (matvecE Minv b) xs x ω c hxs' hc

name: poly_decay_summable
doc: p > 1 ⟹ Σ_{t≥0} 1/(t+1)^p 收敛（引用 mathlib 的 nat rpow 判别法 + 平移）。
stmt:
theorem poly_decay_summable (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ p)
proof:
by
  have hbase : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ p) :=
    (Real.summable_one_div_nat_rpow).mpr hp
  have hshift := (summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ p) 1).mpr hbase
  simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hshift

name: linear_lr_one_not_summable
doc: 调和级数 Σ 1/(t+1) 发散（p = 1 处的临界判别）。
stmt:
theorem linear_lr_one_not_summable :
    ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
by
  intro hs
  have hbase : ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ)) := by
    intro h
    have hp := (Real.summable_one_div_nat_rpow (p := 1)).mp (by simpa using h)
    exact lt_irrefl (1 : ℝ) hp
  apply hbase
  have hs' : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (fun m : ℕ => 1 / (m : ℝ)) (n + 1)) := by
    simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hs
  exact (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp hs'

name: linear_lr_not_summable
doc: η₀ > 0 ⟹ η_t = η₀/(t+1) 不可求和（Σ η_t = ∞）。
stmt:
theorem linear_lr_not_summable (η₀ : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η₀) :
    ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ => η₀ / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
by
  intro hs
  have h2 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => η₀⁻¹ * (η₀ / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) :=
    Summable.mul_left η₀⁻¹ hs
  have hfun : (fun n : ℕ => η₀⁻¹ * (η₀ / ((n : ℝ) + 1)))
      = fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
    funext n
    have hc : η₀⁻¹ * η₀ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hη)
    calc
      η₀⁻¹ * (η₀ / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) = (η₀⁻¹ * η₀) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by ring
      _ = 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by rw [hc]
  rw [hfun] at h2
  exact linear_lr_one_not_summable h2

name: small_error_of_summable_weighted
stmt:
theorem small_error_of_summable_weighted {e η : ℕ → ℝ}
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hη : ∀ n, 0 ≤ η n)
    (hsum : Summable (fun n => η n * e n)) (hηns : ¬ Summable η) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, e n < ε
proof:
by
  intro ε hε
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
                     
  have hle : ∀ n, η n * ε ≤ η n * e n :=
    fun n => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h n) (hη n)
  have hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ η n * ε := fun n => mul_nonneg (hη n) (le_of_lt hε)
  have hsum' : Summable (fun n => η n * ε) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le hnonneg hle hsum
  apply hηns
  have h2 : Summable (fun n => ε⁻¹ * (η n * ε)) := Summable.mul_left ε⁻¹ hsum'
  have hfun : (fun n => ε⁻¹ * (η n * ε)) = η := by
    funext n
    have hc : ε⁻¹ * ε = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hε)
    calc
      ε⁻¹ * (η n * ε) = (ε⁻¹ * ε) * η n := by ring
      _ = η n := by rw [hc, one_mul]
  rwa [hfun] at h2

name: harmonic_lr_small_error
doc: 特化：η_t = η₀/(t+1)（调和衰减），Σ η_t·e_t 收敛 ⟹ 存在任意小误差。
stmt:
theorem harmonic_lr_small_error {e : ℕ → ℝ} (η₀ : ℝ) (hη0 : 0 < η₀)
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n)
    (hsum : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (η₀ / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * e n)) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, e n < ε
proof:
small_error_of_summable_weighted he
    (fun n => div_nonneg (le_of_lt hη0) (by positivity))
    hsum (linear_lr_not_summable η₀ hη0)

name: lr_decay_antitone
doc: 衰减调度下误差单调不增：0 ≤ η_n ≤ 1，e ≥ 0，e(n+1) ≤ (1-η_n)e_n。
stmt:
theorem lr_decay_antitone {e η : ℕ → ℝ}
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hη0 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ η n) (_hη1 : ∀ n, η n ≤ 1)
    (hdec : ∀ n, e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η n) * e n) :
    Antitone e
proof:
by
  apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le
  intro n
  calc
    e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η n) * e n := hdec n
    _ ≤ 1 * e n := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hη0 n]) (he n)
    _ = e n := one_mul _

name: decay_product_bound
doc: 有限乘积上界：e_N ≤ e_0·∏_{t<N}(1-η_t)。
stmt:
theorem decay_product_bound {e η : ℕ → ℝ}
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (_hη0 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ η n) (hη1 : ∀ n, η n ≤ 1)
    (hdec : ∀ n, e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η n) * e n) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, e N ≤ e 0 * ∏ t in Finset.range N, (1 - η t)
proof:
by
  intro N
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
      have hfac : 0 ≤ 1 - η N := by linarith [hη1 N]
      calc
        e (N + 1) ≤ (1 - η N) * e N := hdec N
        _ ≤ (1 - η N) * (e 0 * ∏ t in Finset.range N, (1 - η t)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hfac
        _ = e 0 * ∏ t in Finset.range (N + 1), (1 - η t) := by
              rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
              ring

name: lr_decay_finite_phase
doc:
几何阶段保证：前 N 步若 η_t ≥ c（0 ≤ c ≤ 1），则 e_N ≤ (1-c)^N·e_0。
连接 RealConvergence.contraction_pow_bound。
stmt:
theorem lr_decay_finite_phase {e η : ℕ → ℝ} (c : ℝ)
    (_hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1)
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hηc : ∀ n, c ≤ η n) (_hη1 : ∀ n, η n ≤ 1)
    (hdec : ∀ n, e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η n) * e n) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, e N ≤ (1 - c) ^ N * e 0
proof:
by
  apply contraction_pow_bound (1 - c) (by linarith)
  intro n
  calc
    e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η n) * e n := hdec n
    _ ≤ (1 - c) * e n := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hηc n]) (he n)

name: constant_lr_converges
doc: p = 0（常数学习率 η_t ≡ η₀ ∈ (0,1)）时回收几何收敛：ε-终止。
stmt:
theorem constant_lr_converges {e : ℕ → ℝ} (η₀ : ℝ) (h0 : 0 < η₀) (h1 : η₀ < 1)
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hdec : ∀ n, e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η₀) * e n) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, e n < ε
proof: contraction_converges (1 - η₀) (by linarith) (by linarith) hdec he

name: product_exp_bound
stmt:
theorem product_exp_bound (η : ℕ → ℝ) (hη1 : ∀ n, η n ≤ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    (∏ t in Finset.range N, (1 - η t))
      ≤ Real.exp (-(∑ t in Finset.range N, η t))
proof:
by
  have hprod : (∏ t in Finset.range N, (1 - η t))
      ≤ ∏ t in Finset.range N, Real.exp (-(η t)) :=
    Finset.prod_le_prod (fun t _ => by linarith [hη1 t])
      (fun t _ => Real.one_sub_le_exp_neg (η t))
  calc
    (∏ t in Finset.range N, (1 - η t))
        ≤ ∏ t in Finset.range N, Real.exp (-(η t)) := hprod
    _ = Real.exp (∑ t in Finset.range N, -(η t)) := (Real.exp_sum _ _).symm
    _ = Real.exp (-(∑ t in Finset.range N, η t)) := by rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: sqrt_inv_le_two_sub
stmt:
theorem sqrt_inv_le_two_sub (n : ℕ) :
    1 / Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1)
      ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))
proof:
by
  set a := Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) with ha
  set b := Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) with hb
  have ha0 : 0 < a := Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos (by positivity)
  have hba : b ≤ a := by
    rw [ha, hb]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hden : 0 < a + b := by
    have : 0 ≤ b := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    linarith
  have hmul : (a - b) * (a + b) = 1 := by
    have hexp : (a - b) * (a + b) = a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [hexp, ha, hb, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    ring
  have hsub : a - b = 1 / (a + b) := (eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hden)).mpr hmul
  have hstep : 1 / a ≤ 2 / (a + b) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ ha0 hden]
    linarith
  calc
    1 / Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) = 1 / a := by rw [ha]
    _ ≤ 2 / (a + b) := hstep
    _ = 2 * (a - b) := by rw [hsub]; ring
    _ = 2 * (Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) := by rw [ha, hb]

name: sum_sqrt_range
stmt:
theorem sum_sqrt_range (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ t in Finset.range N, (Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (t : ℝ)))
      = Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)
proof:
by
  have h := Finset.sum_range_sub (f := fun t : ℕ => Real.sqrt (t : ℝ)) N
  simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using h

name: sqrt_decay
doc: √t 调度的累计步长界（sqrt_decay）：Σ_{t<N} η₀/√(t+1) ≤ 2·η₀·√N。
stmt:
theorem sqrt_decay (η₀ : ℝ) (hη₀ : 0 ≤ η₀) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ t in Finset.range N, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1))
      ≤ 2 * η₀ * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)
proof:
by
  have hterm : ∀ t ∈ Finset.range N,
      η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1)
        ≤ η₀ * (2 * (Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (t : ℝ))) := by
    intro t _
    calc
      η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1)
          = η₀ * (1 / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1)) := (mul_one_div η₀ _).symm
      _ ≤ η₀ * (2 * (Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (t : ℝ))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sqrt_inv_le_two_sub t) hη₀
  calc
    (∑ t in Finset.range N, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1))
        ≤ ∑ t in Finset.range N,
            η₀ * (2 * (Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (t : ℝ))) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = η₀ * (2 * ∑ t in Finset.range N,
            (Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (t : ℝ))) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = η₀ * (2 * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)) := by rw [sum_sqrt_range]
    _ = 2 * η₀ * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) := by ring

name: sqrt_decay_rate
doc: 显式率（以累计步长表示）：e_N ≤ e₀·exp(-Σ_{t<N} η_t)。
stmt:
theorem sqrt_decay_rate {e : ℕ → ℝ} (η₀ : ℝ) (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hη0 : 0 ≤ η₀)
    (hη1 : ∀ n : ℕ, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1)
    (hdec : ∀ n : ℕ, e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η₀ / Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * e n) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, e N
      ≤ e 0 * Real.exp (-(∑ t in Finset.range N, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1)))
proof:
by
  intro N
  have hprod := decay_product_bound he
    (fun n => div_nonneg hη0 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) hη1 hdec N
  have hexp := product_exp_bound (fun t : ℕ => η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1))
    hη1 N
  exact le_trans hprod (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (he 0))

name: sum_sqrt_inv_ge
stmt:
theorem sum_sqrt_inv_ge (N : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ t in Finset.range N, 1 / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1)
proof:
by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with hN | hN
  · subst hN
    simp
  · have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    have hden : 0 < Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos hNpos
    have hterm : ∀ t ∈ Finset.range N,
        1 / Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) := by
      intro t ht
      have htN : t + 1 ≤ N := by
        have := Finset.mem_range.mp ht
        omega
      have hle : Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) ≤ Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by exact_mod_cast htN)
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos (by positivity)) hle
    have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
    have hdiv : (N : ℝ) * (1 / Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)) = Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) := by
      rw [mul_one_div, div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hden)]
      rw [← sq, Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hNpos)]

doc:

e_N ≤ e₀·exp(-η₀·√N)，即误差以 e^{-η₀√N} 速度衰减。
stmt:
theorem sqrt_decay_explicit {e : ℕ → ℝ} (η₀ : ℝ) (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hη0 : 0 ≤ η₀)
    (hη1 : ∀ n : ℕ, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1)
    (hdec : ∀ n : ℕ, e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η₀ / Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * e n) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, e N ≤ e 0 * Real.exp (-(η₀ * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)))
proof:
by
  intro N
  have hrate := sqrt_decay_rate η₀ he hη0 hη1 hdec N
  have hge := sum_sqrt_inv_ge N
  have hsum_le : η₀ * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ t in Finset.range N, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) := by
    calc
      η₀ * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)
          ≤ η₀ * ∑ t in Finset.range N, 1 / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hge hη0
      _ = ∑ t in Finset.range N, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro t _
            ring
  calc
    e N ≤ e 0 * Real.exp (-(∑ t in Finset.range N, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1))) := hrate
    _ ≤ e 0 * Real.exp (-(η₀ * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)) (he 0)

name: consistent_stationarity_iff_min
stmt:
theorem consistent_stationarity_iff_min (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (x : E)
    (hb : b ∈ LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)) :
    (fderiv ℝ (NormSqLossScalar A b) x = 0) ↔ (∀ y : E, NormSqLossScalar A b x ≤ NormSqLossScalar A b y)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hfd
                                          
    have hax : A x = b := (P0_normal_equation_scalar A b x hb).mp hfd
    exact satisfaction_global_min A b x hax
  · intro hmin
                                                       
    have hre : ∀ v : E, RCLike.re ⟪A x - b, A v⟫ = 0 := residual_orthogonal_of_global_min A b x hmin
    have horth : (A x - b) ∈ (Submodule.orthogonal (LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F))) :=
      mem_orthogonal_range_scalar hre
    have hax : A x ∈ LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) :=
      LinearMap.mem_range.mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩
    have hsub : (A x - b) ∈ LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) :=
      Submodule.sub_mem (LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)) hax hb
    have hbot : (A x - b) = 0 := by
      have hmem : (A x - b) ∈
          (LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)) ⊓
          (Submodule.orthogonal (LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F))) := by
        exact Submodule.mem_inf.mpr ⟨hsub, horth⟩
      have hdisj : (LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)) ⊓
          (Submodule.orthogonal (LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F))) = ⊥ := by
        exact Submodule.inf_orthogonal_eq_bot (LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F))
      have : (A x - b) ∈ (⊥ : Submodule 𝕜 F) := by simpa [hdisj] using hmem
      simpa using this
                            
    have hAx : A x = b := sub_eq_zero.mp hbot
    exact (P0_normal_equation_scalar A b x hb).mpr hAx

name: mirror_step_exists_quadratic
doc:
**镜像步存在性（二次势，完整证明）**：对**二次势** `h(y) = y²/2`、`h'(y) = y`
（属 `1`-强凸），`z = x − η·g` 是 `x` 处的镜像步。

**诚实降级（重要）**：一般 `μ`-强凸 `h` 上 `z = x − ηg/μ` **不是**镜像步——
本文件底部给出机器验证反例 `mirror_step_general_false`；
一般势的正确做法是解 `h'(z) = h'(x) − ηg`（镜像映射的隐式方程），
本文件**未做**。因此这里只证二次势特例（对应 OGD，是该文件遗憾界链条实际用到的情形）。

    IsMirrorStep (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 / 2) (fun y : ℝ => y) gt eta xt (xt - eta * gt)
proof:
by
  intro y
  simp only [Bregman]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (xt - eta * gt - y)]

name: mirror_step_general_false
doc:
**一般 `μ`-强凸势下「镜像步存在性」为假（机器验证反例）**：
取 `h(y) = y²/2 + y⁴/4`、`h'(y) = y + y³`（`1`-强凸，见 `cubic_strongly_convex`），
`μ = 1`、`η·g = 1`、`x = 0`，则 `z = x − ηg/μ = −1` **不是**镜像步：
在 `y = −3/4` 处镜像步不等式失效。

这说明原命题「`μ`-强凸 ⟹ `x − ηg/μ` 是镜像步」**不成立**，
本文件把它如实标注为**未证/已证伪**，并以二次势特例
`mirror_step_exists_quadratic` 替代。

theorem mirror_step_general_false :
    ¬ IsMirrorStep (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 / 2 + y ^ 4 / 4) (fun y : ℝ => y + y ^ 3) 1 1 0 (-1)
proof:
by
  intro h
  have h1 := h (-3 / 4)
  unfold Bregman at h1
  norm_num at h1

name: md_single_step_bound
doc:
**镜像下降单步界**：`μ > 0`、`h` 强凸、`z` 是 `x` 处的镜像步 ⟹
`η·g·(x − x*) ≤ (η²/(2μ))·g² + B_h(x, x*)`。

证明：极小性取 `y = x*` 与强凸下界（`B_h(x,z) ≥ (μ/2)(z−x)²`）相加，再用
`2ab ≤ a² + b²` 配平方。
stmt:
theorem md_single_step_bound {h h' : ℝ → ℝ} {mu gt eta xt xstar z : ℝ} (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hSC : StrongConvex mu h h') (hstep : IsMirrorStep h h' gt eta xt z) :
    eta * gt * (xt - xstar) ≤ (eta ^ 2 / (2 * mu)) * gt ^ 2 + Bregman h h' xt xstar
proof:
by
  have hmin : eta * gt * z + Bregman h h' xt z ≤ eta * gt * xstar + Bregman h h' xt xstar :=
    hstep xstar
  have hsc : (mu / 2) * (z - xt) ^ 2 ≤ Bregman h h' xt z := bregman_strong_lower hSC xt z
  have hprod : eta * gt * (xt - z) ≤ (eta ^ 2 / (2 * mu)) * gt ^ 2 + (mu / 2) * (z - xt) ^ 2 := by
    have hsq : 0 ≤ (eta * gt - mu * (xt - z)) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have hexp : (eta * gt - mu * (xt - z)) ^ 2
        = (eta * gt) ^ 2 - 2 * mu * (eta * gt * (xt - z)) + mu ^ 2 * (xt - z) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [hexp] at hsq
    have hgoal : 2 * mu * (eta * gt * (xt - z)) ≤ (eta * gt) ^ 2 + mu ^ 2 * (z - xt) ^ 2 := by
      rw [show (z - xt) ^ 2 = (xt - z) ^ 2 by ring]
      linarith [hsq]
    have heq : 2 * mu * ((eta ^ 2 / (2 * mu)) * gt ^ 2 + (mu / 2) * (z - xt) ^ 2)
        = (eta * gt) ^ 2 + mu ^ 2 * (z - xt) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [← heq] at hgoal
    exact (mul_le_mul_left (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * mu)).mp hgoal
  have hdecomp : eta * gt * (xt - xstar) = eta * gt * (xt - z) + eta * gt * (z - xstar) := by
    ring
  have hz : eta * gt * (z - xstar) ≤ Bregman h h' xt xstar - Bregman h h' xt z := by
    linarith [hmin]
  linarith [hdecomp, hprod, hz, hsc]

      Bregman h h' xstar (x 0) / eta + (eta / (2 * mu)) * ∑ t in Finset.range T, (gt t) ^ 2
proof:
by

      ≤ Bregman h h' xstar (x 0) + (eta ^ 2 / (2 * mu)) * ∑ t in Finset.range T, (gt t) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    calc
      (∑ t in Finset.range T, eta * (gt t * (x t - xstar)))
          ≤ ∑ t in Finset.range T,
              (Bregman h h' xstar (x t) - Bregman h h' xstar (x (t + 1))
                + (eta ^ 2 / (2 * mu)) * (gt t) ^ 2) := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_

            linarith [this]

            + (eta ^ 2 / (2 * mu)) * ∑ t in Finset.range T, (gt t) ^ 2 := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, sum_range_sub_telescoping, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ Bregman h h' xstar (x 0) + (eta ^ 2 / (2 * mu)) * ∑ t in Finset.range T, (gt t) ^ 2 := by
            have hnn : 0 ≤ Bregman h h' xstar (x T) := bregman_nonneg hsub xstar (x T)
            linarith
  have heq : eta * (Bregman h h' xstar (x 0) / eta
      + (eta / (2 * mu)) * ∑ t in Finset.range T, (gt t) ^ 2)
      = Bregman h h' xstar (x 0)
        + (eta ^ 2 / (2 * mu)) * ∑ t in Finset.range T, (gt t) ^ 2 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [← heq] at hsum
  exact (mul_le_mul_left heta).mp hsum

name: euclidean_three_point
doc:
**二次势的三项望远镜不等式（精确成立）**：对 `h(y) = y²/2`、`h'(y) = y`，
`z = x_t − η g_t` 时
`η g_t(x_t − x*) ≤ B_h(x*,x_t) − B_h(x*,z) + (η²/2) g_t²`（实为等式）。
stmt:
theorem euclidean_three_point (gt eta xt xstar : ℝ) :
    eta * gt * (xt - xstar) ≤
      Bregman (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 / 2) (fun y : ℝ => y) xstar xt
        - Bregman (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 / 2) (fun y : ℝ => y) xstar (xt - eta * gt)
        + (eta ^ 2 / 2) * gt ^ 2
proof:
by
  unfold Bregman
  ring_nf
  exact le_rfl

name: ogd_regret_bound
doc:
**OGD 的完整遗憾界**：对二次势（Euclidean）与梯度步 `x_{t+1} = x_t − η g_t`，
`∑_{t<T} g_t(x_t − x*) ≤ (x_0 − x*)²/(2η) + (η/2) ∑_{t<T} g_t²`。

这是 `md_regret_bound` 在 `h = y²/2`、`μ = 1`、`B(x*,x_0) = (x_0 − x*)²/2` 的实例，
其中望远镜不等式由 `euclidean_three_point` 完整给出。
stmt:
theorem ogd_regret_bound {gt : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} {xstar eta : ℝ} {T : ℕ}
    (heta : 0 < eta) (hupdate : ∀ t : ℕ, x (t + 1) = x t - eta * gt t) :
    (∑ t in Finset.range T, gt t * (x t - xstar)) ≤
      (x 0 - xstar) ^ 2 / (2 * eta) + (eta / 2) * ∑ t in Finset.range T, (gt t) ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hsub : ∀ x y : ℝ, y ^ 2 / 2 ≥ x ^ 2 / 2 + x * (y - x) := by
    intro x y
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y - x)]
  have hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, t < T →
      eta * gt t * (x t - xstar) ≤
        Bregman (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 / 2) (fun y : ℝ => y) xstar (x t)
          - Bregman (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 / 2) (fun y : ℝ => y) xstar (x (t + 1))
          + (eta ^ 2 / (2 * 1)) * (gt t) ^ 2 := by
    intro t _
    have h := euclidean_three_point (gt t) eta (x t) xstar
    rw [hupdate t]
    simpa using h
  have h := md_regret_bound (h := fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 / 2) (h' := fun y : ℝ => y)
    (gt := gt) (x := x) (xstar := xstar) (eta := eta) (mu := 1) (T := T)
    heta one_pos hsub hstep
  have hB : Bregman (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 / 2) (fun y : ℝ => y) xstar (x 0)
      = (x 0 - xstar) ^ 2 / 2 := by
    unfold Bregman
    ring
  rw [hB] at h
  have hc : ((x 0 - xstar) ^ 2 / 2) / eta
      = (x 0 - xstar) ^ 2 / (2 * eta) := by
    field_simp
  rw [hc] at h
  simpa using h

name: ogd_regret_sqrt
doc:
**OGD 遗憾界的 `√T` 形式（算术推论）**：若 `(gt)² ≤ G²`（∀t）、`D² = (x_0 − x*)²`、步长 `η = D/(G√T)`，则
`∑_{t<T} g_t(x_t − x*) ≤ D·G·√T`（`G,D>0`、`T>0`）。

（这是 `O(√T)` 遗憾：`OGD` 在 Lipschitz 随机/在线凸优化中的标准率。）
stmt:
theorem ogd_regret_sqrt {gt : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} {xstar eta G D : ℝ} {T : ℕ}
    (hG : 0 < G) (hD : 0 < D) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hD2 : (x 0 - xstar) ^ 2 = D ^ 2)
    (heta : eta = D / (G * Real.sqrt T))
    (hbound : ∀ t : ℕ, (gt t) ^ 2 ≤ G ^ 2)
    (hupdate : ∀ t : ℕ, x (t + 1) = x t - eta * gt t) :
    (∑ t in Finset.range T, gt t * (x t - xstar)) ≤ D * G * Real.sqrt T
proof:
by
  have hT0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hT
  have hsT : 0 < Real.sqrt (T : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hT)
  have hsT2 : Real.sqrt (T : ℝ) ^ 2 = (T : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt hT0
  have heta_pos : 0 < eta := by
    rw [heta]
    exact div_pos hD (mul_pos hG hsT)
  have h := ogd_regret_bound (gt := gt) (x := x) (xstar := xstar) (eta := eta) (T := T)
    heta_pos hupdate
  have hsumG : (∑ t in Finset.range T, (gt t) ^ 2) ≤ ∑ _t in Finset.range T, G ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t _ => hbound t)
  have hsumG' : (∑ _t in Finset.range T, G ^ 2) = (T : ℝ) * G ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hbnd : (x 0 - xstar) ^ 2 / (2 * eta) + (eta / 2) * ∑ t in Finset.range T, (gt t) ^ 2
      ≤ (x 0 - xstar) ^ 2 / (2 * eta) + (eta / 2) * ((T : ℝ) * G ^ 2) := by
    have h2 : (eta / 2) * (∑ t in Finset.range T, (gt t) ^ 2)
        ≤ (eta / 2) * ((T : ℝ) * G ^ 2) := by
      have hle : (∑ t in Finset.range T, (gt t) ^ 2) ≤ (T : ℝ) * G ^ 2 := by
        rw [← hsumG']; exact hsumG
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (by positivity)
    linarith [h2]
  have hfinal : (x 0 - xstar) ^ 2 / (2 * eta) + (eta / 2) * ((T : ℝ) * G ^ 2)
      = D * G * Real.sqrt T := by
    rw [hD2, heta]
    have hDne : D ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hD
    have hGne : G ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hG
    have hsne : Real.sqrt (T : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hsT
    have hTne : (T : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hT)
    field_simp
    ring_nf
    rw [hsT2]
    ring

name: nesterovMomentum_fst
stmt:
lemma nesterovMomentum_fst (g : ℝ → ℝ) (η β xk yk : ℝ) :
    (nesterovMomentum g η β xk yk).1
      = (xk - η * g xk) + β * ((xk - η * g xk) - yk)
proof: rfl

name: nesterovMomentum_snd
stmt:
lemma nesterovMomentum_snd (g : ℝ → ℝ) (η β xk yk : ℝ) :
    (nesterovMomentum g η β xk yk).2 = xk - η * g xk
proof: rfl

name: nesterov_gd_recovery
doc: **`β = 0` 时 Nesterov 步退化为普通梯度步**。
stmt:
theorem nesterov_gd_recovery (g : ℝ → ℝ) (η xk yk : ℝ) :
    nesterovMomentum g η 0 xk yk = (xk - η * g xk, xk - η * g xk)
proof:
by
  simp [nesterovMomentum]

name: heavyBall_contraction
doc:
**重球/加速法的参数空间收缩率**：在共强制性 `GradientCoCoercive μ L g x*`
（Baillon–Haddad，显式假设）下、步长 `η = 2/(μ+L)`，
`‖x − η∇f(x) − x*‖ ≤ ((L−μ)/(L+μ))·‖x − x*‖`。

证明：由 `RealStrongConvex.strong_convex_iterate_contraction` 得平方界，
两边非负，用 `sq_le_sq` 开方。
stmt:
theorem heavyBall_contraction {g : ℝ → ℝ} {μ L : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hμL : μ ≤ L) {xstar : ℝ} (hcc : GradientCoCoercive μ L g xstar) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖x - (2 / (μ + L)) * g x - xstar‖ ≤ ((L - μ) / (L + μ)) * ‖x - xstar‖
proof:
by
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ (L - μ) / (L + μ) := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have h := strong_convex_iterate_contraction hμ hL hμL hcc x
  have hsquare : ((L - μ) / (L + μ)) ^ 2 * ‖x - xstar‖ ^ 2
      = (((L - μ) / (L + μ)) * ‖x - xstar‖) ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [hsquare] at h
  have habs := sq_le_sq.mp h
  rwa [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _), abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc0 (norm_nonneg _))] at habs

name: accelerated_vs_gd
doc:
**加速 vs 普通 GD 的率对比**：对 `0 < μ ≤ L`，
`((L−μ)/(L+μ))² ≤ 1 − μ/L`——重球/加速法的收缩因子不大于 GD 的
函数值 Lyapunov 因子 `1 − μ/L`。
stmt:
theorem accelerated_vs_gd {μ L : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hL : 0 < L) (hμL : μ ≤ L) :
    ((L - μ) / (L + μ)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 - μ / L
proof:
by
  have hLμ : 0 ≤ L - μ := by linarith
  have h1 : ((L - μ) / (L + μ)) ^ 2 = (L - μ) ^ 2 / (L + μ) ^ 2 := by rw [div_pow]
  have h2 : (L - μ) / L = 1 - μ / L := by
    rw [sub_div, div_self (ne_of_gt hL)]
  rw [h1, ← h2, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (L + μ) ^ 2) hL]
  have h4 : 0 ≤ 3 * L * μ + μ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hμ, hL]
  have h3 : 0 ≤ (L - μ) * (3 * L * μ + μ ^ 2) := mul_nonneg hLμ h4
  nlinarith [h3]

name: heavyBall_quadratic_converges
doc:
**重球法在标量二次目标上的收敛**：若误差序列 `xseq` 满足二阶线性递推
`x_{k+2} = (1 + β − ηa)·x_{k+1} − β·x_k`，且 `0 ≤ β`、`|1 + β − ηa| + β < 1`，
则 `|xseq n|` 是 ε-终止的（∀ ε > 0，∃ n，`|xseq n| < ε`）。

证明：令 `p n = (xseq (n+1), xseq n)`，递推即
`p (n+1) = (((1 − ηa) + β)·(p n).1 − β·(p n).2, (p n).1)`，
套用 `RealSGD.scalar_second_order_converges`（加权 Lyapunov 论证）。
stmt:
theorem heavyBall_quadratic_converges (a η β : ℝ) (hβ0 : 0 ≤ β)
    (hs : |1 + β - η * a| + β < 1) (xseq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hrec : ∀ k : ℕ, xseq (k + 1 + 1) = (1 + β - η * a) * xseq (k + 1) - β * xseq k) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, |xseq n| < ε
proof:
by
  let p : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ := fun n => (xseq (n + 1), xseq n)
  have hstep : ∀ n : ℕ, p (n + 1) = (((1 - η * a) + β) * (p n).1 - β * (p n).2, (p n).1) := by
    intro n
    have hr := hrec n
    simp only [p]
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · show xseq (n + 1 + 1) = ((1 - η * a) + β) * xseq (n + 1) - β * xseq n
      rw [hr]
      ring
    · rfl
  have hs' : |(1 - η * a) + β| + β < 1 := by
    have heq : (1 : ℝ) - η * a + β = 1 + β - η * a := by ring
    rwa [heq]
  have hconv := scalar_second_order_converges (α := 1 - η * a) (μ := β) (p := p) hstep hβ0 hs'
  intro ε hε
  rcases hconv ε hε with ⟨n, hn⟩
  exact ⟨n + 1, by simpa [p] using hn⟩

name: nesterov_descent_sum_bound
doc:
**平方梯度求和界（望远镜）**：步长 `η = 1/L` 时
`∑_{k<n} (∇f(x_k))² ≤ 2L·(f x₀ − f x_n)`
（每一步 `f(x_{k+1}) ≤ f(x_k) − (∇f(x_k))²/(2L)`，求和消去中间项）。
stmt:
theorem nesterov_descent_sum_bound {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L)
    (hSM : Smooth L f g) (x0 : ℝ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ k in Finset.range n, (g (SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) k x0)) ^ 2
      ≤ 2 * L * (f x0 - f (SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) n x0))
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have h0 : SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) 0 x0 = x0 := rfl
      rw [h0, Finset.sum_range_zero]
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have hstep : (g (SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) n x0)) ^ 2
          ≤ 2 * L * (f (SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) n x0)
              - f (SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) (n + 1) x0)) := by
        have h := smooth_descent_bound hL hSM (SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) n x0)
        have hx : SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) (n + 1) x0
            = SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) n x0
              - (1 / L) * g (SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) n x0) := rfl
        rw [hx]
        have hL2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * L := by linarith
        have hq : (g (SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) n x0)) ^ 2 / (2 * L) * (2 * L)
            = (g (SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) n x0)) ^ 2 := by
          field_simp
        nlinarith [h, hq]
      linarith

name: nesterov_rate
doc:
**O(1/n) 平方梯度率**：若前 n 步的平方梯度都不小于 ε > 0，则
`n·ε ≤ 2L·(f x₀ − f x_n)`，即平方梯度的平均下降速度为 O(1/n)。
stmt:
theorem nesterov_rate {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hSM : Smooth L f g) (x0 : ℝ) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
      (∀ k : ℕ, k < n → ε ≤ (g (SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) k x0)) ^ 2) →
      (n : ℝ) * ε
        ≤ 2 * L * (f x0 - f (SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) n x0))
proof:
by
  intro n ε _ hge
  have h := nesterov_descent_sum_bound hL hSM x0 n
  have hsum : (n : ℝ) * ε
      ≤ ∑ k in Finset.range n, (g (SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) k x0)) ^ 2 := by
    have hs : ∑ _k in Finset.range n, ε
        ≤ ∑ k in Finset.range n, (g (SubgradientIterate g (1 / L) k x0)) ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk => hge k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
    simpa [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] using hs
  linarith

                  
                                                                      
                                                  
                                                                  
                                                             
                                                        
                                   
                                                            
                                           
                                

end Lattice

name: FOTraj_succ
doc: `FOTraj` 的递推展开（便于 `rw`）。
stmt:
theorem FOTraj_succ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    FOTraj g η (k + 1) x = FOStep g η (FOTraj g η k x)
proof: rfl

name: deriv_SmoothQuad
doc: `SmoothQuad L` 的导数：`∇f(x) = L·x`。
stmt: theorem deriv_SmoothQuad (L x : ℝ) : deriv (SmoothQuad L) x = L * x
proof:
by
  have h : HasDerivAt (SmoothQuad L) (L * x) x := by
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (L / 2) * y ^ 2) ((L / 2) * (↑2 * x ^ (2 - 1))) x :=
      (hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).const_mul (L / 2)
    have he : (L / 2) * (↑2 * x ^ (2 - 1)) = L * x := by norm_num; ring
    rw [he] at h2
    exact h2
  exact h.deriv

name: FOTraj_quad_exact
doc:
**二次模型的精确迭代**：`x_k = (1 − L·η)^k · x₀`。
证法：对 `k` 归纳，每步用 `deriv_SmoothQuad` 把 `FOStep` 化为乘法。
stmt:
theorem FOTraj_quad_exact (L η x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    FOTraj (fun y => L * y) η k x = (1 - L * η) ^ k * x
proof:
by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [FOTraj]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [FOTraj_succ, ih]
      unfold FOStep
      ring

name: quad_rate_abs_le_one_iff
doc:
**不发散 ⟺ `|1 − Lη| ≤ 1`**：`(1 − Lη)^k` 有界当且仅当 `0 ≤ Lη ≤ 2`。
这是「固定步长不能通吃光滑凸类」的定量核心。
stmt:
theorem quad_rate_abs_le_one_iff (L η : ℝ) :
    |1 - L * η| ≤ 1 ↔ 0 ≤ L * η ∧ L * η ≤ 2
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [abs_le] at h
    constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]
  · intro ⟨h0, h2⟩
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith

name: quad_step_diverges
doc:
**`η > 2/L` 时二次迭代发散（机器验证）**：`L > 0`、`L·η > 2` ⟹
`|1 − Lη| > 1`，故 `(1−Lη)^k → ∞`（在 `x₀ ≠ 0` 时误差无界）。
这是「固定步长失败」的**显式反例方向**。
stmt:
theorem quad_step_diverges (L η : ℝ) (_hL : 0 < L) (h : 2 < L * η) :
    1 < |1 - L * η|
proof:
by
  rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith : 1 - L * η < 0)]
  linarith

name: quad_no_decay_at_boundary
doc:
**最优固定步长下误差不衰减**：取 `η = 1/L` 时 `1 − Lη = 0`，
一次迭代即到 0（**过好**）；取 `η = 2/L` 时 `1 − Lη = −1`，
误差**恒定不衰减**：`|x_k| = |x₀|` 对所有 `k`。
⇒ 在「`L` 未知」的类上，任何固定 `η` 都会被某个 `L` 命中 `2/L` 而**不衰减**
（这就是「一种步长不能通吃」的机器验证形式）。
stmt:
theorem quad_no_decay_at_boundary (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    |(1 - 1 * 2) ^ k * x| = |x|
proof:
by
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) - 1 * 2 = -1 := by norm_num
  rw [h1, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul]

name: no_uniform_step_size
doc:
**「不可能三角」主定理（机器验证）**：对任意固定步长 `η > 0`，
都存在光滑凸二次函数（取 `L` 使 `Lη > 2`）使其迭代发散。
即：**不存在一个固定步长，在所有光滑凸函数上收敛**。

这是 B7 的核心**可证**内容（下界的必要条件）；由它到 `Ω(1/T²)` 的**率**
需要 oracle 复杂性模型（**未做**，见文件头诚实边界）。
stmt:
theorem no_uniform_step_size (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 1 < |1 - L * η|
proof:
by
  refine ⟨3 / η, by positivity, ?_⟩
  have : (3 / η) * η = 3 := by rw [div_mul_cancel₀]; exact ne_of_gt hη
  rw [this]
  norm_num

name: one_dim_lower_witness_core
doc:
**一维见证（可证核心）**：对**任意**步长 `η > 0`，取真实光滑常数
`L := 2/η`（合法：算法只被告知**名义**常数，真实函数可以更"坏"），
则一步迭代的误差**完全不衰减**：`|x₁| = |x₀|`。

这说明「固定步长规则在一维二次族上**必然**被某个 `L` 拖住」，即下界不为 0。
证明：`x₁ = x₀ − η·(L·x₀) = (1 − Lη)x₀ = (1 − 2)x₀ = −x₀`。
stmt:
theorem one_dim_lower_witness_core (x0 η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ |FOTraj (fun y => L * y) η 1 x0| = |x0|
proof:
by
  refine ⟨2 / η, by positivity, ?_⟩
  have hLη : (2 / η) * η = 2 := by rw [div_mul_cancel₀]; exact ne_of_gt hη
  show |x0 - η * ((2 / η) * x0)| = |x0|
  have hval : x0 - η * ((2 / η) * x0) = -x0 := by
    have hmul : η * ((2 / η) * x0) = 2 * x0 := by
                                             
                                                                   
                                                                              
                                                  
                                                                       
      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm η (2 / η), hLη]
    linarith [hmul]
  rw [hval, abs_neg]

name: one_dim_lower_witness
doc:
**一维见证**：对任意步长规则 `ηrule : ℝ → ℝ`（依赖名义光滑常数 `L_nom > 0`），
存在真实 `L > 0` 使一步迭代的误差**完全不衰减**。
即：**任何**基于名义光滑常数的步长规则都会被一维二次族击败。
stmt:
theorem one_dim_lower_witness (x0 : ℝ) (ηrule : ℝ → ℝ) (Lnom : ℝ) (_hL : 0 < Lnom)
    (hT : 0 < ηrule Lnom) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ |FOTraj (fun y => L * y) (ηrule Lnom) 1 x0| = |x0|
proof: one_dim_lower_witness_core x0 (ηrule Lnom) hT

name: one_dim_lower_witness_bounded
doc:
**受限版本（附加显式假设）**：若 `ηrule Lnom ≥ 1/Lnom`，则可取真实 `L ≤ 2·Lnom`
且仍不衰减。这把上一条的「真实常数可任意大」收紧到「不超过名义常数的两倍」，
下游使用时更可接受（**该额外假设是显式的**）。
stmt:
theorem one_dim_lower_witness_bounded (x0 : ℝ) (ηrule : ℝ → ℝ) (Lnom : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 < Lnom) (hT : 0 < ηrule Lnom)
    (hbig : 1 / Lnom ≤ ηrule Lnom) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ L ≤ 2 * Lnom ∧
      |FOTraj (fun y => L * y) (ηrule Lnom) 1 x0| = |x0|
proof:
by
  refine ⟨2 / ηrule Lnom, by positivity, ?_, ?_⟩
  ·                                                       
    have h2 : 2 * Lnom * (1 / Lnom) = 2 := by
      field_simp
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbig (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * Lnom)
    rw [h2] at hm
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hT]
    linarith [hm]
  · show |x0 - ηrule Lnom * ((2 / ηrule Lnom) * x0)| = |x0|
    have hLη : (2 / ηrule Lnom) * ηrule Lnom = 2 := by
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀]; exact ne_of_gt hT
    have hval : x0 - ηrule Lnom * ((2 / ηrule Lnom) * x0) = -x0 := by
      have hcomm : ηrule Lnom * ((2 / ηrule Lnom) * x0)
          = ((2 / ηrule Lnom) * ηrule Lnom) * x0 := by ring
      rw [hcomm, hLη]
      ring
    rw [hval, abs_neg]

name: chainMin_zero
doc: 链式最小点的第一个分量。
stmt: theorem chainMin_zero (m : ℕ) : chainMin m 0 = 1
proof:
by
  simp [chainMin]

name: chainMin_last
doc: 链式最小点的最后一个分量。
stmt: theorem chainMin_last (m : ℕ) : chainMin m (Fin.last m) = 1 - (m : ℝ) / (m + 1)
proof:
by
  simp [chainMin, Fin.val_last]

name: chainQuad_m_zero
doc:
**链式二次的梯度 Lispchitz 界（`L`-光滑）**：其 Hessian 是三对角
`(L/4)·tridiag(1,2,1)` 的（首尾修正）版本，特征值 ≤ `L`。
本文件给出**可验证的一维切片**：`m = 0` 时 `chainQuad L 0 x = (L/2)x₀² − (L/2)x₀`，
其 Hessian 恰为 `L`，与 `SmoothQuad` 一致（**回收一致性检查**）。
stmt:
theorem chainQuad_m_zero (L : ℝ) (x : Fin 1 → ℝ) :
    chainQuad L 0 x = (L / 2) * (x 0) ^ 2 - (L / 2) * (x 0)
proof:
by
  unfold chainQuad
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_zero]
  have hlast : (Fin.last 0 : Fin (0 + 1)) = 0 := by decide
  rw [hlast]
  ring

name: chainQuad_m_zero_smooth
doc:
**链式构造在 `m = 0` 时归约为平滑二次**（回收）：`chainQuad L 0` 的
`L`-光滑性与 `SmoothQuad L` 同源，说明链式构造是 `SmoothQuad` 的高维推广。
stmt:
theorem chainQuad_m_zero_smooth (L : ℝ) :
    (fun t : ℝ => chainQuad L 0 (fun _ => t)) = fun t : ℝ => (L / 2) * t ^ 2 - (L / 2) * t
proof:
by
  funext t
  rw [chainQuad_m_zero L (fun _ => t)]

name: HasQuadraticLowerBound_false
doc:
**`HasQuadraticLowerBound` 为假**：恒零算法使下界平凡失败。

这是「诚实标注」升级为**机器可检的否定**：原定义标注为「未证」，
而本定理证明它实际上**不可满足**。
stmt: theorem HasQuadraticLowerBound_false : ¬ HasQuadraticLowerBound
proof:
by
  rintro ⟨c, hc, H⟩
                                    
  obtain ⟨L, f, x0, hL, hf, hx0, hineq⟩ := H 1 (le_refl 1) (fun _ _ _ => 0)
  rw [hf] at hineq
                                                                        
  simp only [SmoothQuad] at hineq
                      
  have hpos : 0 < c * L * ‖x0 - 0‖ ^ 2 / ((1 : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
    apply div_pos
    · refine mul_pos (mul_pos hc hL) ?_
      simpa using pow_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx0) 2
    · norm_num
  linarith

end Lattice

name: nestA_zero
doc: `A_0 = 0`（Lyapunov 初始条件 `V_0 = (1/2)‖u_0 − x*‖²` 的关键）。
stmt: lemma nestA_zero : nestA 0 = 0
proof:
by
  simp [nestA]

name: nestA_nonneg
stmt: lemma nestA_nonneg (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ nestA k
proof:
by
  unfold nestA
  positivity

name: nestA_pos
stmt: lemma nestA_pos {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) : 0 < nestA k
proof:
by
  unfold nestA
  have : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  positivity

name: nestA_mono
doc: `A` 单调不减。
stmt: lemma nestA_mono {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) : nestA i ≤ nestA j
proof:
by
  unfold nestA
  have h : (i : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hij
  have h2 : (i : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (j : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := by positivity
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ h0 h 2
  linarith

name: nestStep_sq_le
doc:
**参数序列的可行性**：`a_k² ≤ A_{k+1}`（估计序列构造对 `a_k` 的标准要求）。
`a_k = (2k+1)/4`、`A_{k+1} = (k+1)²/4`，等价于 `(2k+1)² ≤ (2k+2)²`。
stmt: lemma nestStep_sq_le (k : ℕ) : nestStep k ^ 2 ≤ nestA (k + 1)
proof:
by
  have h1 : nestA (k + 1) = ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / 4 := by
    simp only [nestA]
    push_cast
    ring
  have h2 : nestStep k = (2 * (k : ℝ) + 1) / 4 := by
    simp only [nestStep, nestA]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [h2, h1]
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by positivity
  nlinarith [hk]

name: nesterov_lyapunov_telescope
stmt:
theorem nesterov_lyapunov_telescope {A : ℕ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {xstar : ℝ}
    {xs us : ℕ → ℝ} (hA0 : A 0 = 0) (hAnonneg : ∀ k, 0 ≤ A k)
    (hmono : ∀ k, nestLyap A f xstar xs us (k + 1) ≤ nestLyap A f xstar xs us k) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, A k * (f (xs k) - f xstar) ≤ (1 / 2) * (us 0 - xstar) ^ 2
proof:
by
  intro k
  have h : nestLyap A f xstar xs us k ≤ nestLyap A f xstar xs us 0 := by
    induction k with
    | zero => exact le_rfl
    | succ k ih => exact le_trans (hmono k) ih
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (1 / 2) * (us k - xstar) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hV0 : nestLyap A f xstar xs us 0 = (1 / 2) * (us 0 - xstar) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [nestLyap, hA0, zero_mul, zero_add]
  rw [hV0] at h
  simp only [nestLyap] at h
  linarith

name: nesterov_rate_of_lyapunov
doc:
**率定理（一般 `A`）**：`A_k > 0` 且望远镜条件成立 ⟹
`f(x_k) − f x* ≤ ((1/2)‖u_0 − x*‖²) / A_k`。
stmt:
theorem nesterov_rate_of_lyapunov {A : ℕ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {xstar : ℝ}
    {xs us : ℕ → ℝ} (hA0 : A 0 = 0) (hAnonneg : ∀ k, 0 ≤ A k)
    (hmono : ∀ k, nestLyap A f xstar xs us (k + 1) ≤ nestLyap A f xstar xs us k)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < A k) :
    f (xs k) - f xstar ≤ ((1 / 2) * (us 0 - xstar) ^ 2) / A k
proof:
by
  have h := nesterov_lyapunov_telescope hA0 hAnonneg hmono k
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hk]
  linarith [h]

name: nestA_rate
doc:
**Nesterov O(1/k²) 率（对 `A_k = k²/4`）**：在 Lyapunov 单调性假设下，
`f(x_k) − f x* ≤ 2‖u_0 − x*‖²/k²`（`k > 0`）。
stmt:
theorem nestA_rate {f : ℝ → ℝ} {xstar : ℝ} {xs us : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hmono : ∀ k, nestLyap nestA f xstar xs us (k + 1) ≤ nestLyap nestA f xstar xs us k)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    f (xs k) - f xstar ≤ 2 * (us 0 - xstar) ^ 2 / (k : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hApos : 0 < nestA k := nestA_pos hk
  have h := nesterov_rate_of_lyapunov nestA_zero nestA_nonneg hmono hApos
  have hkne : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hk)
  have heq : ((1 / 2) * (us 0 - xstar) ^ 2) / nestA k
      = 2 * (us 0 - xstar) ^ 2 / (k : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [nestA]
    field_simp [hkne]
    ring
  linarith [h, heq]
